role: The immutable 3D double vector used by every ray trace, look-vector, motion and rotation in the game.

members.name: xCoord
members.note: no shared C Vec3 type: coordinates are plain doubles in locals and structs at every call site

members.name: createVectorHelper
members.note: no heap vectors; callers carry (x, y, z) triples

members.name: Vec3
members.note: the -0.0 normalization is applied inline where the port reached it

members.name: subtract
members.note: inlined as plain double arithmetic at each call site

members.name: normalize
members.note: one per-file copy (1.0E-4 zero-vector rule kept); the same math is inlined elsewhere

members.name: crossProduct
members.note: no native caller has needed it yet; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: distanceTo
members.note: inlined; the entity variants (getDistanceSqToEntity) have per-file helpers

members.name: getIntermediateWithXValue
members.note: one shared helper, axis-tagged; the 1.0000000116860974E-7 epsilon kept

members.name: rotateAroundX
members.note: with MathHelper's table cos/sin; used by the block renderers

notes: The port spreads Vec3 across callers by design (SPEC: flat locals, no pointer graphs); each per-file copy keeps Java's exact float/double widening. Verified only the citations above; other call sites were not enumerated. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): data structure or helper replaced by fixed arrays or inlined arithmetic (GPU contract), behavior covered by its callers. Formerly listed as missing: crossProduct has no native caller yet; everything else is ported inline or per-file without a shared Vec3 type, which is the deliberate GPU-contract shape (no heap vectors).
